messages:
Alex W: hey team — small coverage gap showed up for tonight. I need to swap primary for the 00:00-06:00 window. real quick context: I have a late deploy review that overlaps with the first half and can't be primary.
Maria P: @Alex W thanks for the heads up. which segments of the rota does this affect? primary or primary+secondary?
Alex W: primary only. Kevin is already secondary until 04:00; the gap is 04:00-06:00 where there's no scheduled secondary (we had someone OOO). I can move to secondary for 06:00-08:00 though.
Kevin L: I can extend to 06:00 if needed, but I've got a meeting at 05:30 that I can't move. Could do 04:00-05:30.
Jess R: I can take 05:30-08:00 if that helps, then Alex can take 00:00-04:00 primary and Kevin covers 04:00-05:30.
Alex W: that would work for me. so proposal: Alex primary 00:00-04:00, Kevin primary 04:00-05:30, Jess primary 05:30-08:00. Secondary stays the same (Maria until 02:00, rotation bot indicates backup coverage from infra-team). ok to confirm?
Maria P: @Rotation Bot can you bump the rota and post updates to oncall channel + Google Calendar? also please update the handoff doc link.
Rotation Bot: Reminder: to request swaps, include time ranges and consent from both parties. Auto-updating calendar after confirmation.
Oncall Bot: NOTE: You are about to modify oncall rota for eng-oncall. Make sure to run `/oncall confirm-swap 1864123456` to apply changes.
Kevin L: confirmed for 04:00-05:30. I've set my Slack status to :on_call: for that range.
Jess R: confirmed for 05:30-08:00. added a quick note to the handoff doc w/ customer-facing services to watch (routing, kv-cache).
Alex W: thanks all. paste of handoff checklist I added to doc:
```
Handoff checklist (short):
- current primary pager: check open incidents & acked pages
- top 3 services: inference-gateway, model-runner, cache-proxy
- check /status and latest deploys (k8s namespace: prod-inference)
- escalation steps: ping SRE lead -> paging policy -> oncall-svc
- runbook links: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-primary
```
Maria P: Alex — quick reminder to pin the runbook in the thread and include the short blast radius note for tonight's deploy.
Alex W: pinned runbook link. Also added an entry in the incident playbook for degraded KV-cache behavior (because of the new quantized model rollout).
Rotation Bot: Swap request logged. Calendar invites sent to Alex W, Kevin L, Jess R. Rota updated: Alex (00:00-04:00), Kevin (04:00-05:30), Jess (05:30-08:00).
Oncall Bot: /oncall confirm-swap 1864123456 executed by Alex W at 1864123600 — notifications posted to #eng-oncall and #general.
Maria P: nice. one last ask: whoever is primary at 02:00, please do a quick health-check of inference-gateway (latency P99) and post results in this thread.
Alex W: will do at 02:00 and will handoff notes here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Kevin L: thanks — i'll set an alarm for 04:45 to prep handover.
Jess R: same, i'll watch metrics 05:00-05:30. good luck team :rocket:
